name: Verb ledger (uv / cargo)
summary: Borrows from uv and cargo: each step becomes one terse past-tense line with a right-aligned bold verb (Resolved, Updated, Created, Reused), printed only when the step finishes. A transient spinner status line shows only the in-flight step, and the title is the first and only header.

step_states: pending: not shown (no list of future steps). running: single transient bottom line with Rich status spinner (dots, ASCII fallback '|/-\\') plus the step label, dim. ok: permanent line with bold green right-aligned verb in a 10-col field; unchanged uses dim verb 'Unchanged'. warn: bold yellow 'warning' verb. fail: bold red 'error' verb, then bold red 'Failed' summary verb. Verb word carries the state, so NO_COLOR still reads correctly.
header: One line: bold 'pkgdx init' plus dim project root. No rule, no second title row.
success_summary: 'Finished  6 steps in 2.9s' with bold green verb; omit the step count when all unchanged and print 'Finished  nothing to change' instead.
warning_presentation: Inline in sequence as a yellow 'warning' verb line carrying Result.detail; hints collected after the summary as git-style 'hint' lines (dim verb, normal text) so next actions land last, where the eye ends. Summary counts warnings.
failure_presentation: Red 'error' line with detail and message, one 'hint' line, then red 'Failed' summary stating progress (2 of 6). No traceback for expected errors; a dim pointer to -d. Overall status is final, never a frozen spinner.
state_change_reporting: Carried by the verb itself: Created / Updated / Reused / Unchanged / Installed, derived from Result.detail. Every state change is visible without -d.
non_tty_behaviour: Identical lines without colour, without the spinner and without right-alignment padding changes (same 10-col field so it greps well). Lines flush as steps finish. Header line is kept. Example plain line: '    Updated  prek.toml, 2 hooks added'.
guidance_refs: standard-cli §4 brief output on success and inform on state change
toolchain-logging §3 stderr via console, TTY check on the written stream
risks: Verb vocabulary must be derived from Result.detail (or extend Result with a verb field), mild coupling
Hints appearing after the summary requires collecting them in a list
Right-aligned verbs need a fixed 10-col width; long verbs would overflow
Ctrl-C (obs 8) not handled by layout alone; needs a KeyboardInterrupt wrapper printing 'Interrupted' and exiting 130
curation_note: uv/cargo style. Derive the verb from Result.detail with a small keyword map and document in the module docstring that a real implementation needs _core to return a change kind.
